You're working in a Next.js 16 + Tailwind v4 app at /Users/rizelscarlett/Documents/agent-experiments/voice-experiments/live-captions/apps/web (product: Earshot, live AI captions for YouTube videos; dark theme, amber accent `accent`, red `live`, ink-* greys defined in packages/shared/src/theme.css).

The home page hero has a fake product demo on the right, in src/components/hero-demo/. All pieces share one simulated session from src/components/hero-demo/state.tsx (read it first: `useHeroDemo()` gives captionsOn/setCaptionsOn, showCaptions/setShowCaptions, showTranscript/setShowTranscript, playing, etc.). It's a scripted talk on a clock; no real audio.

YOUR JOB: make src/components/hero-demo/ExtensionPopup.tsx and src/components/hero-demo/PlayerControls.tsx interactive and driven by that state. Edit ONLY those two files (and icons.tsx if you need another shared icon). Other agents are editing VideoFrame.tsx and TranscriptCard.tsx in parallel, and I'm editing HeroDemo.tsx and page.tsx; don't touch those or state.tsx. If you need something from state.tsx, tell me in your report instead of changing it.

The demo copies the real product, so look at the real UIs first and match their wording and behaviour:
- Extension popup: apps/extension/entrypoints/popup/App.tsx (one level up from apps/web: ../extension/...). Its switch is role="switch" with aria-checked and aria-label "Start captions"/"Stop captions", a status badge, and a status line.
- Player controls: src/components/WatchExperience.tsx (and nearby components) in apps/web: Stop/Start captions, show captions (CC), transcript panel, fullscreen.

ExtensionPopup.tsx should:
- Make the toggle a real switch button bound to captionsOn (setCaptionsOn), with the knob sliding (transition) and the icon tile amber when on, ink-800 when off, like the real popup.
- Header badge: red pulsing "Live" when on; a muted "Off" (or whatever the real StatusBadge shows for idle) when off.
- Status line: "Captioning this tab on youtube.com" when on; something like "Captions are off for this tab" when off (match the real popup's idle wording if it has one).
- Keep the current look and size (w set by parent, rounded-[20px] bg-ink-900 card).

PlayerControls.tsx should:
- "Stop captions" button (red, square glyph) toggles to "Start captions" (amber or ink style matching the real watch page's start state, play/record glyph) via setCaptionsOn. Same state as the popup switch, so they stay in sync.
- CC button toggles showCaptions (aria-pressed, active style when on).
- Transcript button toggles showTranscript (aria-pressed, active style when on).
- Fullscreen button: request fullscreen on the demo player. Simplest robust approach: find the closest ancestor with `[data-hero-demo]` (I'll add `data-hero-demo` to the demo root in HeroDemo.tsx) and call requestFullscreen on it, or exitFullscreen when already fullscreen; skip silently if unsupported. aria-label "Full screen"/"Exit full screen".
- Every control gets aria-label, a title tooltip, hover state, visible keyboard focus (focus-visible ring/outline in accent), and the pill keeps its current look. ToolIcon in icons.tsx renders a span; turn controls into real buttons (you can change ToolIcon into a button or add a new component in icons.tsx; nothing outside these files uses ToolIcon).

Code style: TypeScript strict (noUncheckedIndexedAccess on), "use client", Tailwind, no new deps, no em dashes in visible text. Verify with `npx tsc --noEmit -p .` from apps/web. Do NOT start or restart a dev server (one is running on 127.0.0.1:3100; I'll check visually). Report: what you changed, anything you wanted from state.tsx or HeroDemo.tsx.

content.text:
I made the extension popup and the player controls clickable. Both now use the shared demo state, so they stay in sync. `npx tsc --noEmit -p .` passes. I haven't looked at it in the browser and didn't touch the dev server. I only changed `ExtensionPopup.tsx`, `PlayerControls.tsx` and `icons.tsx`.

**Extension popup**
- **Switch:** it's a real switch bound to `captionsOn`, labelled "Stop captions" / "Start captions" like the real popup. When on, the track is amber and the knob slides right. When off, the track is `ink-600`, the colour the real popup uses.
- **Icon tile:** amber when on, `ink-800` when off.
- **Badge:** red pulsing "Live" when on. When off, a muted "Off", which is what the real status badge shows when idle.
- **Status line:** "Captioning this tab on youtube.com" when on. When off, I used the real popup's idle text: "Turn on to caption whatever is playing in this tab." The line is announced to screen readers when it changes.
- The card's look and size are unchanged.

**Player controls**
- **Stop / Start captions:** "Stop captions" keeps its red square. Turning it off shows "Start captions" in amber with a play icon, matching the real watch page.
- **CC button:** toggles `showCaptions`. It's labelled "Show captions", with a "Show captions" / "Hide captions" tooltip, and gets the darker pressed style when on.
- **Transcript button:** toggles `showTranscript`. It's labelled "Transcript panel" with a "Show transcript" / "Hide transcript" tooltip, the same wording as the watch page.
- **Full screen button:** finds the nearest `[data-hero-demo]` element and makes it full screen, or exits if something is already full screen. If that element is missing or the browser doesn't support it, nothing happens. The label and icon switch between "Full screen" and "Exit full screen".
- Every control has a label, a tooltip, a hover state and an amber keyboard focus outline. The pill's look is unchanged.

**Icons:** `ToolIcon` is now a real button. It takes a required `label` and passes extra props like `aria-pressed`, `onClick` and `ref` through to the button.

**Differences from the real UI**
- The real watch page's Stop button is grey, but I kept the demo's red one as you asked.
- The real popup says "Captioning this tab's audio." when on. I used your "on youtube.com" wording instead.

**What you need to do:** add `data-hero-demo` to the demo root in `HeroDemo.tsx`. Until then the full screen button does nothing. I didn't need anything from `state.tsx`.
